name: BubleChat
author: spekos

sections.description:
BubleChat adds a live chat widget to your WordPress site. Visitors can send messages from the widget and receive replies there. Your team reads and answers conversations in the hosted BubleChat dashboard. You can also enable optional contact channels such as WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, Viber, SMS, phone or email.

  • Connect your BubleChat account in one click and choose your site.
  • Turn the bubble on or off.
  • Manage appearance, channels and conversations in the BubleChat dashboard.
  • English and Czech translations.

A BubleChat account and a connection to the external BubleChat service are required. The service provides hosted conversations, operator chat and bubble configuration. Free and paid service plans are available; the WordPress plugin itself is free and does not process payments.

External services

This plugin relies on BubleChat, operated by RBL JM z.s., at https://bublechat.rbljm.cz to display the chat bubble and handle conversations. Connecting or manually configuring a site and enabling the bubble activates this service integration. The plugin does not contact BubleChat just because it is activated without a connected site.

  • On public pages, when the plugin is enabled and a valid site ID is configured, the visitor’s browser loads https://bublechat.rbljm.cz/widget.js. This service script requests bubble configuration and provides hosted chat; it is not a plugin updater. Requests include the public site ID and normal request metadata such as IP address and browser information.
  • The widget stores a per-site conversation token and the selected interface language in browser local storage. Sending a message includes the public site ID, any existing conversation token and the message body; an optional e-mail address for offline replies is included in the message. Messages are stored by BubleChat. The widget polls for replies while the chat panel is open and periodically refreshes bubble configuration. External channel buttons open the corresponding channel when selected by the visitor.
  • Account connection redirects the administrator to https://bublechat.rbljm.cz/connect/wordpress (or /auth for registration), sending the WordPress administration return URL and a temporary connection state. The administrator signs in or registers on BubleChat, not in WordPress.
  • After connection, /api/public/wp/claim exchanges a one-time code and public site ID for a site-specific connection secret. WordPress stores this secret in its settings to generate signed administration links. BubleChat account passwords and account sessions are not stored by the plugin.
  • Opening the connected plugin settings retrieves the public site name from /api/public/widget/config and caches it temporarily. “Open BubleChat administration” opens /api/public/wp/login with the public site ID, timestamp and a signature. “Disconnect” sends a signed request to /api/public/wp/disconnect to revoke the connection before clearing local connection settings.

Site owners are responsible for informing visitors about the chat service and establishing the applicable legal basis for processing and browser storage. Disabling the plugin’s “Show chat bubble” option stops the plugin from loading the public widget. Uninstalling removes local plugin settings; it does not delete the external BubleChat account or hosted conversations.

Service: https://bublechat.rbljm.cz
Terms of service: https://bublechat.rbljm.cz/obchodni-podminky
Privacy policy: https://bublechat.rbljm.cz/ochrana-osobnich-udaju
Data processing agreement: https://bublechat.rbljm.cz/zpracovatelska-smlouva
Browser storage information: https://bublechat.rbljm.cz/technicke-ukladani-dat
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP in Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and activate it.
  2. Open BubleChat in the WordPress admin menu. The widget stays hidden until a site ID is configured and the widget is enabled.
  3. Click “Create a new account” to register a new customer, or “Connect BubleChat account” to use an existing account.
  4. Confirm your email if requested, then create or choose your own site. Its ID is saved automatically in WordPress. Complete the connection within 24 hours; otherwise restart it from the plugin.
  5. Check that “Show chat bubble” is enabled, then open a public page of your site to see the widget.
sections.faq:
Do I need a BubleChat account?

Yes. A free account is available.

Where do I change colors and channels?

In the BubleChat dashboard. Use the “Open BubleChat administration” button.

How do I update an existing installation?

Upload the new ZIP in Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and choose to replace the existing plugin. Updating preserves the connected site, connection secret and visibility setting. Do not uninstall the old plugin first, because uninstalling deletes its local settings.

Does this ZIP publish the BubleChat service?

No. The WordPress plugin and the hosted BubleChat service are released separately. Server-side fixes must also be published on the BubleChat service.
sections.changelog:
1.3.2

  • Clarify live chat and initial setup, and use the BubleChat name consistently.

1.3.1

  • Load the widget and all connection requests from the current BubleChat service domain.
  • Document service requests, browser storage, connection secrets and direct legal links.
  • Align release metadata and refresh Czech translations.

1.3.0

  • Simplify connected settings with a direct administration button, visibility switch and disconnect action.
  • Support signed administration links and revocation of the site connection.

1.2.0

  • Dedicated customer registration from WordPress, without using an existing session automatically.
  • Preserve the connection after email confirmation and create or select an owned site without copying IDs.

1.0.0

  • First release.
